cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10...3.28)

project(lcutilityc VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

if(LC_ENABLE_COUNT)
    add_definitions(-DLC_ENABLE_COUNT)
endif()

# exe: testsorts
#
# Development-only test/benchmark driver. It is generated by
# DeepSeek V4 Flash 1017 and is not part of the installed library.
#
# It depends on the external "vector" library from LC Projects,
# https://github.com/Lawrence-Charland/LC-Vector, expected under
# $HOME/.local by default. If you cloned lcutilityc
# without vector, either build/install vector first or delete this target
# together with its properties/link lines and the testsorts-verify test
# below. The lcutilityc and lcsorts targets do not depend on it.
add_executable(testsorts src/testsorts.c src/lcsorts.c)

set_target_properties(testsorts PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

target_include_directories(testsorts PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include /home/lawrence/.local/include)

target_link_directories(testsorts PRIVATE /home/lawrence/.local/lib)

target_link_libraries(testsorts PRIVATE vector)

# exe: lcutilityc
#
# Scratch driver only: a throwaway program for poking at the library by hand.
# It is not part of the library API and is not a deliverable; it may be
# rewritten or deleted at any time. The real outputs are the lcsorts shared
# library and the public headers.
add_executable(lcutilityc src/main.c src/lcsorts.c)

set_target_properties(lcutilityc PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

target_include_directories(lcutilityc PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# lib: lcsort
add_library(lcsorts SHARED src/lcsorts.c)

target_include_directories(lcsorts PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

set_target_properties(lcsorts PROPERTIES
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

install(TARGETS lcsorts
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})

install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME testsorts-verify COMMAND testsorts verify)
